versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-dataworks-metadata.

- Provides DataWorks metadata browsing and non-destructive metadata write operations via Aliyun CLI.
- Supports listing and retrieving catalogs, databases, tables, columns, partitions, data lineage, datasets & versions, and metadata collections.
- Enables non-destructive updates: update table/column business metadata, register lineage, create/update datasets/collections, add entities.
- Strictly forbids all delete/remove operations for safety; directs deletion requests to the DataWorks console.
- Enforces CLI safety: AI-Mode & user-agent binding, confirmation for all writes, idempotency on create/add, and enforced timeouts.
- Includes clear prerequisites, CLI command rules, and user guidance for credentials and permission management.

alibabacloud-dataworks-metadata 0.0.1-beta.2

- Enforces strict "read + non-destructive write" policy: all delete and remove operations are explicitly out of scope.
- CLI requirements updated: minimum Aliyun CLI version is now 3.3.3; strengthens how plugin installation and configuration is handled.
- Requires global AI-Mode and custom user-agent for every session; disables them on exit to avoid leak into user’s environment.
- Every CLI command now includes explicit read/connect timeouts to prevent indefinite hangs.
- Enforces idempotency and user confirmation for all create/update/write actions (check-then-act, must get confirmation before writes).
- Documentation, triggers, and operation guides updated to clarify allowed and forbidden actions, security cautions, and safe practices.

Initial beta release of DataWorks metadata skill for Alibaba Cloud.

- Enables browsing and management of DataWorks metadata: catalogs, databases, tables, columns, partitions, datasets, versions, and metadata collections via Aliyun CLI.
- Provides commands for data lineage analysis, metadata collection operations, and business metadata updates.
- Includes comprehensive prerequisites and parameter rules to ensure secure and correct operation.
- Supports triggers such as "dataworks metadata", "data lineage", "catalog", "table info", and more.
